_note: QWERTx Pro plans. Product IDs are not secret; the Stripe secret key lives in Cloudflare as STRIPE_SECRET_KEY. Prices are created in Stripe automatically from 'amount' (in cents) under 'lookupKey' the first time someone checks out, so changing a price here means changing amount AND giving it a new lookupKey. Subscribers keep the price they signed up at. Set checkoutOpen to true to put live checkout buttons on the public Pro page.
